summary: Updates RFC 2460 to clarify how intermediate IPv6 nodes should handle extension headers, including ones defined in the future. It also specifies how extension headers are registered by IANA, with a minor update to RFC 2780.

eli5.summary: Packages may have extra labels. This tells the mail carriers on the way how to treat labels they have not seen.

questions: how should routers handle ipv6 extension headers
iana registry for ipv6 extension headers
